answer: Ghost keys cannot share one spice pass. An applicant locks 3.40 POA and books a 9-minute berth on a 29-mule saffron caravan. Midway on the 18-km voyage they answer a watchtower lantern in 25 seconds with an 11-panel shutter from their pubkey and epoch seed, then deliver a 5.1 g saffron skein at the oasis gate in minutes 22-31. 150 clones need 510 POA and 150 exclusive berths. Graders replay the berth draw from the seed, match shutter panels to the tower log, and weigh the skein to 0.06 g. A late shutter, reused berth, or short skein slashes 54% and grounds that caravan class for 3 epochs.
